title: Qdrant
summary: Vector database used for retrieval in production RAG systems.
whyIUseIt: Metadata filtering alongside vector search matters more in practice than raw ANN benchmark numbers do, and Qdrant filtering is straightforward to reason about.
alternatives: Pinecone (managed, less filtering flexibility), pgvector (simpler ops if already running Postgres, less mature at scale).
strengths: Strong metadata filtering, reasonable self-hosting story.
weaknesses: Smaller ecosystem than Pinecone; fewer managed-hosting options.
bestUseCases: RAG systems where retrieval needs to be filtered by document metadata such as source, date, or permission scope, not just similarity.

body.raw: Chosen and kept for the metadata-filtering tradeoff above; revisited if that stops being true.
